## Problem and change

Explain the problem and what this change does. Link a related issue or discussion when applicable.

## Verification

Describe the checks actually performed, their results and any remaining limits. For translations, identify the language and review performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and related documentation or language links are updated where needed.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for credentials, private information and unintended files.
- [ ] Verification claims describe checks actually performed.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this material under the repository's MIT license; third-party attribution is preserved.

A maintainer reviews contributions and decides whether to merge. Opening a PR does not guarantee acceptance.
